notes.raw:
Phase changes: 411 K, $\alpha-\beta$ transition point of FeS; $\Delta H^{\circ}=0.560$ kcal/mol. 598 K, β - γ transition point of FeS; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.095$ kcal/mol. 1043 K, Curie temperature of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0$ kcal/mol. 1185 K, α - γ transition point of Fe; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 0.215$ kcal/mol. 1465 K, melting point of FeS; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 7.670$ kcal/mol. Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations:
298.15-411 K: $Cp^o$ = -80.385 + 199.956 $x10^{-3}T$ + 29.540 $x10^5T^{-2}$
411-598 K: $H^o-H_{298}^o$ = -80.385 $x10^{-3}T$ + 99.978 $x10^{-6}T^2$ - 29.540 $x10^2T^{-1}$ + 24.987 $Cp^o$ = 17.351
598-1465 K: $H^o-H_{298}^o$ = 17.351 $x10^{-3}T$ - 4.921 $Cp^o$ = 6.041 + 6.678 $x10^{-3}T$ + 16.479 $x10^5T^{-2}$
1465-1600 K: $H^o-H_{298}^o$ = 6.041 $x10^{-3}T$ + 3.339 $x10^{-6}T^2$ - 16.479 $x10^2T^{-1}$ + 3.499 $Cp^o$ = 15.000
$H^o-H_{298}^o$ = 15.000 $x10^{-3}T$ + 4.085
Reaction equations (kcal/mol):
298.15-411 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -13.098 - 84.335 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 93.747 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 2759.650 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -13.098 + 84.335 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 93.747 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 1379.825 \text{T}^{-1} - 505.108 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
411-598 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -43.006 + 13.400 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 6.231 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 194.350 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -43.006 - 13.400 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 6.231 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 97.175 \text{T}^{-1} + 106.061 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
598-1043 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -34.586 + 2.090 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 2.892 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 1453.550 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -34.586 - 2.090 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 2.892 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 726.775 \text{T}^{-1} + 23.970 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1043-1185 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -11.026 - 41.891 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 17.819 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 1682.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -11.026 + 41.891 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 17.819 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 841.025 \text{T}^{-1} - 282.575 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1185-1465 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -34.639 - 3.636 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} + 2.128 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 1563.050 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -34.639 + 3.636 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T - 2.128 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} - 781.525 \text{T}^{-1} - 10.534 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
1465-1600 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -34.053 + 5.323 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} - 1.211 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 84.850 \text{T}^{-1}$
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -34.053 - 5.323 \times 10^{-3} \text{T} \ln T + 1.211 \times 10^{-6} \text{T}^{2} + 42.425 \text{T}^{-1} + 49.098 \times 10^{-3} \text{T}$
Sources: Enthalpy of formation at 298 K from Adami (1). Low-temperature heat capacities and entropy at 298 K from Gronvold (48). High-temperature data based on Coughlin (25) and Vaisburd (122).
